시편-4-1.title: 시편 4장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-4-1.exegesis: 8. An ascription of praise to a delivering God, whose favor is an efficient benefit.
시편-4-1.theologicalNote: 8. An ascription of praise to a delivering God, whose favor is an efficient benefit.

시편-4-2.title: 시편 4장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-4-2.exegesis: PSALM 4 Psa 4:1-8 . On Neginoth, that is, stringed instruments, as the kind of musical accompaniment. On other parts of title, see Introduction., The historical occasion was probably the same as that of the foregoing [see on Psa 3:1]. The writer, praying for further relief, admonishes his enemies of the vanity of attacking God's servant, exhorts them to repentance, and avows his confidence and peace in God's favor. 1. Hear-- as in Psa 3:4 . God of my righteousness-- or, "my righteous God, as my holy hill" ( Psa 2:6 ), who will act towards me on righteous principles. thou hast enlarged-- expresses relief afforded in opposition to "distress," which is expressed by a word denoting straits or pressure. Past favor is a ground of hope for the future.

시편-4-3.title: 시편 4장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-4-3.exegesis: 2. sons of men-- men of note or prominence (compare 2Ch 21:9 ). turn my glory-- or, "royal dignity." into shame-- or, "reproach." vanity-- a foolish and hopeless enterprise ( Psa 2:1 ). leasing-- a lie.

시편-4-4.title: 시편 4장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-4-4.exegesis: 3. godly-- an object as well as subject of divine favor (compare Psa 105:14 , 15 ).
시편-4-4.theologicalNote: 3. godly-- an object as well as subject of divine favor (compare Psa 105:14 , 15 ).

시편-4-5.title: 시편 4장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-4-5.exegesis: 4. Stand in awe-- ( Ep 4:26 ), from Septuagint, "be angry." Both clauses are qualified by "not."
시편-4-5.theologicalNote: 4. Stand in awe-- ( Ep 4:26 ), from Septuagint, "be angry." Both clauses are qualified by "not."

시편-4-6.title: 시편 4장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-4-6.exegesis: 5. Not only repent, but manifest penitence by sacrifices or righteousness or righteous sacrifices, &c.
시편-4-6.theologicalNote: 5. Not only repent, but manifest penitence by sacrifices or righteousness or righteous sacrifices, &c.

시편-4-7.title: 시편 4장 7절 역사문법적 주해
시편-4-7.exegesis: 6-7. Contrast true with vain confidence. light of thy countenance upon us-- figure for favor ( Nu 6:26 ; Psa 44:3 ; 81:16 ).
시편-4-7.theologicalNote: 6-7. Contrast true with vain confidence. light of thy countenance upon us-- figure for favor ( Nu 6:26 ; Psa 44:3 ; 81:16 ).
